## Recent work:
Implemented bounded webhook retries: configurable `max_attempts` (default 3), exponential backoff capped at 2 seconds, transport-error retry/re-raise, and retry of server errors while preserving immediate 4xx failures. Added retry-success, exhaustion, and server-error tests. Webhook tests: 8 passed. Full suite: 44 passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Diff is limited to two webhook files.

Established search-index baseline: `pytest -q tests/search/test_index.py` produced 18 passed and 2 failures because rebuilt documents omit recently updated invoice descriptions.

The API-router split and ordered “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” procedure remain outstanding.
